scope: Machine registration of the Phase-B control-first protocol. This packet copies frozen design rules and records blockers; it does not execute controls, candidate trajectories, production measurements, or solver calls.

dimension_estimators.finite_boundary_rule: undefined when the observed value is outside the open calibration interval

dimension_estimators.fit_window: all preregistered training sizes; no post-hoc window selection

dimension_estimators.observable: return probability of the lazy random walk P=(I+D^-1*A)/2 on the symmetrized Hasse graph

bounded_preflight_fit.method: ordinary least-squares slope of log(P_return) on log(step)
bounded_preflight_fit.purpose: arithmetic diagnostic only; not a production plateau claim

dimension_estimators.production_plateau_rule: a contiguous walk-time window with at least four points must be frozen by the large-N extension design before production
dimension_estimators.ensemble_aggregation: annealed probability-weighted return curve before fitting; quenched per-history summaries must also be reported in production
dimension_estimators.isolated_vertex_rule: an isolated vertex is an absorbing one-vertex component
dimension_estimators.component_reporting: connected-component sizes and finite-size saturation must be reported

correlation_length_observable.graph: undirected graph formed by symmetrized cover relations
correlation_length_observable.spectral_gap_proxy: xi_gap,c^2=1/(1-lambda_2,c) for each nontrivial connected component
correlation_length_observable.component_aggregation: vertex-weighted root-mean-square over nontrivial components; isolated vertices have zero coverage weight
correlation_length_observable.ensemble_diameter_ratio: conditional root-mean-square sqrt(E[(xi/diameter)^2 | xi defined and diameter>0])
correlation_length_observable.validity_rule: undefined only when no nontrivial connected component exists; nontrivial vertex coverage must be reported

scaling_protocol.seed_aggregation: retain per-seed estimates; report medians and simultaneous 95-percent bootstrap intervals without pooling trajectories across seeds

acceptance_rules.dimension_estimator_selection_rule: all defined estimators enter every pairwise check; fewer than two defined estimators is a stop; no post-hoc subset selection
acceptance_rules.negative_control_rule: stop if the negative control satisfies the candidate acceptance pattern, or if fewer than one defined dimension-estimator difference exceeds 0.5 with its simultaneous 95-percent interval excluding zero
acceptance_rules.threshold_ambiguity_rule: any confidence interval crossing an acceptance threshold is inconclusive and stops promotion

stop_conditions: candidate sampler normalization or independent replay fails
target dimension or metric enters the candidate path
two required dimension estimators disagree beyond the preregistered tolerance
correlation length does not grow in the preregistered scaling window
negative control is indistinguishable under the preregistered comparison
holdout requires refitting or changes the frozen fugacities
measurement cost exceeds the separately approved versioned budget

spectral_protocol.freeze_source: positive and negative controls only, before candidate production measurements are opened
selection_algorithm_obligations: use the registered lazy symmetrized Hasse walk and isolated-vertex convention
require at least four local-slope points and a minimum log-time span
exclude finite-size saturation using the component return floor
require positive local slopes and a preregistered plateau-dispersion bound
choose the longest eligible log-span and break ties by the earliest window
freeze all numerical thresholds on control training data only and validate without refit on control holdout data
required_diagnostics: window stability across held-out control seeds
spectral_protocol.failure_rule: no independently validated stable window means no spectral-dimension estimator; retain only an exploratory graph-diffusion diagnostic

statistical_protocol.sampling_unit: per-seed batch estimate; trajectories are never pooled across seeds
statistical_protocol.seed_count_rule: determine and freeze training and holdout seed counts by control-only precision and coverage simulation before candidate access
statistical_protocol.negative_control_rule_required: use preregistered simultaneous interval separation from an equivalence band for at least two defined estimators; undefined estimators never count as separation
failure_rules: a negative control satisfying the candidate pattern stops promotion
an interval touching the equivalence band is INCONCLUSIVE
excess undefined bootstrap mass stops promotion
control failure cannot be repaired by adding seeds or retuning thresholds after holdout inspection

registered_controls.purpose: detect dimension-like behavior caused by generic growth combinatorics
verify that the measurement pipeline can recover a supplied control dimension
verify invariance under relabeling before any dimension comparison

geometric_dimension_control.construction: fixed-cardinality uniform sprinklings in a supplied four-dimensional Minkowski Alexandrov interval
geometric_dimension_control.purpose: end-to-end recovery check for the dimension-measurement pipeline with dimension four supplied

bdg_action_evaluation_control.purpose: evaluate supplied dimension-four BDG coefficients and nonlocality scale on independently replayed geometric controls

required_before_that_name_is_used: dimension-four action coefficients and nonlocality scale

positive_control_extension.promotion_boundary: the geometric control must replay independently before BDG action evaluation; neither control is candidate emergence evidence

independent_replay_design.small_n_oracle: existing brute-force masks and frozen unlabeled transition instrument through n=5
independent_replay_design.second_large_n_implementation: frontier-antichain order-ideal iterator with no calls to the primary generator
independent_replay_design.shared_surface: serialized relation rows, frozen fugacities, counter-stream seed, and artifact schema only; down-set generation, local-statistic deltas, normalization, and ticket selection are independently implemented
required_comparisons: exact transition normalizers and branch probabilities through n=5
all relabelings through the bounded exact oracle domain
trajectory digests for every bounded implementation-preflight seed
relation and observable digests for preregistered large-N replay chunks before any production authorization
independent_replay_design.failure_rule: any discrepancy blocks artifact promotion; no retry with a replacement seed

resource_supervision_design.execution_model: worker subprocess supervised by a parent process
resource_supervision_design.promotion_protocol: write to a temporary directory and atomically promote only after schema, digest, and replay validation
resource_supervision_design.retry_policy: zero retries; timeout or OOM is not replaced by another seed

evidence.sampling_unit: per-seed batch estimate; trajectories are never pooled across seeds

evidence.purpose: detect dimension-like behavior caused by generic growth combinatorics
verify that the measurement pipeline can recover a supplied control dimension
verify invariance under relabeling before any dimension comparison

evidence.replay_failure_rule: any discrepancy blocks artifact promotion; no retry with a replacement seed

allowed: bounded implementation and audit evidence already recorded
forbidden: Spin-2 response or universal coupling claim
complete finite ON semantics lattice claim
